note: GD.41 include-style mounts, FastAPI. routers/users.py's `router = APIRouter()` and routers/flows.py's `router = ServiceRouter(prefix="/flows")` (ServiceRouter subclasses APIRouter in core/base.py, the PrefectRouter / UserAPIRouter shape) are included into routers/__init__.py's `router = APIRouter(prefix="/core")` by module attribute (`users.router`, `flows.router` with `prefix="/v1"`), and that router into main.py's app with `prefix="/svc"` (`from routers import router as core_router`): a two-level include chain whose own and include prefixes compose. The client calls non-`/api` prefixes, so only the mount pairs them.
